objects.name: Analytic 1724
objects.description: For iOS, detect Lockscreen Bypass from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application State via Apple MDM [InstalledApplicationList / ManagedApplicationList]; Protected Configuration via Apple MDM [DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: iOS:MDM
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: MDM-managed authentication policy changes only. Any lock policy weakening outside MDM-authorized change is anomalous. Derive from MDM policy management logs.
Approved accessibility and Device Admin apps that may interact with lockscreen for legitimate purposes (enterprise kiosk). Derive from MDM catalog.
Default 10s between lock state and anomalous app activity. Lock-bypass is near-instantaneous.
